blocks.text: Kisi jism ki energy us ki work karne ki salahiyat (capacity) hai. Energy ki do bunyadi qismein hain:

blocks.title: Kinetic aur potential energy
blocks.text: Kinetic energy woh energy hai jo jism ke paas us ki harkat (motion) ki wajah se hoti hai, aur potential energy woh energy hai jo jism ke paas us ki badli hui jagah (position) ki wajah se hoti hai.
Kinetic energy aur potential energy dono mechanical energy ki qismein hain.
Kinetic energy

Aayein chalte hue jism ki kinetic energy ka formula nikalein. Ek car sarak par constant speed se chal rahi hai. Agar engine band (OFF) kar dein to bhi woh rukne se pehle kuch faasla tay karti hai. Jab tak woh chal rahi hai, sarak ki friction (ragar) ke khilaf work kar rahi hai; yani is dauran woh friction f ke barabar force lagati hai. Agar rukne tak faasla d ho to car ka work fd hai. Yeh work car apni harkat ki wajah se karti hai, aur harkat ki wajah se work karne ki salahiyat hi kinetic energy hai. Is liye car ki kinetic energy fd ke barabar hai. blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: K.E. = ½ mv² mein speed square hoti hai: speed dugni karein to K.E. chaar guna ho jati hai. Mass dugna karein to K.E. sirf dugni hoti hai.

blocks.title: Example 4.3
blocks.problem: 18620 N weight wali car 16 m s⁻¹ ki speed se chal rahi hai. Brake lagaye jate hain aur woh 80 m mein ruk jati hai. Us par lagne wali friction ki average force nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: v = 16 m s⁻¹, d = 80 m, w = 18620 N, f = ?
Rukne se pehle car ki kinetic energy us ke kiye gaye work ke barabar hai: ½ mv² = f d
Pehle mass nikalein: m = w / g = 18620 N / 9.8 m s⁻² = 1900 kg
Qeematein rakhein: ½ × 1900 kg × (16 m s⁻¹)² = f × 80 m, yani 243 200 J = f × 80 m

blocks.text: Potential energy
Potential energy jism ke paas is wajah se hoti hai ke woh kisi force field (maslan gravitational field) mein kisi khaas jagah par hai, ya woh dabi/khinchi hui (constrained) halat mein hai.
Dabaye hue spring mein jama energy woh potential energy hai jo spring ke paas us ki dabi (compressed) ya khinchi (stretched) halat ki wajah se hai. Is energy ko elastic potential energy kehte hain.
Absolute potential energy

blocks.title: Absolute gravitational potential energy
blocks.text: Kisi jagah par cheez ki absolute gravitational potential energy woh work hai jo gravitational force cheez ko us jagah se infinity (bohat door, jahan gravity ki force zero ho jati hai) tak le jane mein karti hai.

Gravitational force ka work ya potential energy nikalne ka formula mgh sirf Zameen ki satah ke qareeb theek hai, jahan gravitational force taqreeban constant hai. Lekin agar jism ko space mein bohat door le jayein, maslan point 1 se N tak (Fig. 4.11), to gravitational force constant nahi rehti, kyun ke yeh faasle ke square ke ulat (inversely) badalti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Door jane par gravity ki force badalti hai, is liye rasta chhote qadmon Δr mein kata gaya hai. Har qadam mein force taqreeban constant hai. r₁ aur r₂ Zameen ke markaz O se naape jate hain, satah se nahi; N bohat door (infinity par) hai.

Is mushkil ka hal yeh hai ke 1 aur N ke darmiyan faasle ko chhote qadmon mein baant dein, har qadam ki lambai Δr, taa ke har qadam mein force constant rahe. Phir sab qadmon ka work jor kar kul work nikal aata hai. Agar points 1 aur 2 ke Zameen ke markaz O se faasle r₁ aur r₂ hon (Fig. 4.11), to pehle qadam (point 1 se 2) ka work yun nikalte hain. Isay Zameen ke markaz se faasle r par jism ki gravitational potential energy ki absolute qeemat bhi kehte hain.

Dhyan dein: r barhe to U kam negative hoti hai, yani U barhti hai. Matlab jism ko Zameen se oopar uthayein to us ki P.E. barhti hai. Agar jism ko infinity tak le jana ho to us par GMm/R work karna parega, taa ke us ki P.E. zero ho jaye.
Zameen ki satah par absolute potential energy r = R (Zameen ka radius) rakh kar milti hai:

Minus ka nishan batata hai ke Zameen ki gravitational field mass m ko apni taraf kheenchti hai (attractive hai). Yeh expression woh work ya energy batata hai jo jism ko Zameen ki gravitational field se bahar nikalne ke liye chahiye, jahan Zameen ke lihaz se us ki potential energy zero hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek cycle ki kinetic energy 150 J hai. Usi mass par speed dugni ho to K.E. kya hogi, aur mass teen guna aur speed aadhi ho to (short question 4.9)? Zameen ka mass 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg, Suraj ka 1.99 × 10³⁰ kg aur faasla 160 million km ho to Zameen ki gravitational P.E. nikalein (numerical 4.3).
blocks.explanation: K.E. mv² ke mutabiq badalti hai: dugni speed se 4 guna, yani 600 J. Teen guna mass aur aadhi speed: 3 × ¼ = ¾ guna, yani 112.5 J. U = −GMm / r = −(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹)(1.99 × 10³⁰)(6.0 × 10²⁴) / (1.6 × 10¹¹) = −4.98 × 10³³ J, jo kitab ke −4.97 × 10³³ J ke qareeb hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Energy = work karne ki salahiyat; kinetic (harkat se) aur potential (jagah se), dono mechanical energy.
K.E.: rukti car f d = ½ mv² work karti hai, is liye K.E. = ½ mv² (unit joule). Example 4.3: f = 3040 N.
P.E.: force field mein jagah ya dabi/khinchi halat (spring ki elastic P.E.). mgh sirf satah ke qareeb theek hai.
Absolute P.E.: rasta chhote qadmon Δr mein; F = GMm/(r₁r₂); W(1→2) = −GMm(1/r₁ − 1/r₂); jor se U = −GMm/r; satah par U_g = −GMm/R (4.13), minus kyun ke field attractive hai.
